questions.prompt: pi-agent-core holds the loop but no model call. What happens when a program starts it without a function that calls a model?
options: It stops with an error that asks for a stream function
It calls the first model service it finds
It reads the last session file and continues
It writes the answer from its own memory
questions.explanation: pi-agent-core depends only on pi-ai and carries no list of model services. It refuses to run until you pass streamFn or call setDefaultStreamFn().

questions.prompt: A program installs pi-coding-agent and nothing else. Which packages does it get?
options: Only pi-coding-agent, because it is the top package
pi-coding-agent and pi-ai, but not pi-agent-core
None, because a package cannot depend on another package
questions.explanation: pi-coding-agent depends on pi-agent-core, and pi-agent-core depends on pi-ai. Installing the top package brings the whole stack.

questions.prompt: Which package holds the pi command, the sessions, the system prompt and the tools?
options: The mcp and codemode helper packages
questions.explanation: pi-coding-agent is the top layer. It adds the command, the sessions, the system prompt and the tools on top of the loop and the model layer.
